title: Issuer-or-clinician invariant
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload. QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload: “At least one of is or cn must be present”.

statements.label: Issuer-or-clinician invariant
statements.requirement: Validation SHALL fail a DVCMin whose vx has neither is nor cn (invariant must-have-issuer-or-clinician-name). The issuer SHALL NOT sign a payload that fails validation.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-PAY-004 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-PAY-004 STT-PAY-007 an invalid payload is refused, naming each rule` (AssemblePayloadTest.kt)).
